title: ui_net
summary: MSUI runs the keepalive CMSG_PING loop, measures round-trip on SMSG_PONG into NetworkClient.LatencyMs, and draws the main-bar performance meter from the real UI-MainMenuBar-PerformanceBar art tinted by the FrameXML thresholds (green <=300 ms, yellow <=600, red above) with a 'Latency: Nms' tooltip.
